tagline: Owned by the people we cover.
sector: A policyholder owned mutual life insurer selling whole life and final expense through appointed producers.
founded_place_size: central Vermont; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
about: Aldervale Mutual is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is central Vermont, and this commission covers phase 1: producer sales and compliance kit.
audience: Households aged 35 to 60 with modest savings, buying because they do not want to leave a burden. They trust plainness and distrust anything that reads like a sales pitch.
price_positioning: Premiums run 45 to 180 dollars a month, drop in comparison irrelevant. A regulated mutual at a modest, accessible band, deliberately not a private wealth manager and not a discount direct response mailer.

palette.name: Ink Navy
palette.usage: The producer name and the Disclosure Text, as on countercard_2026_print.pdf, and any premium. Never a ground, panel or rule.

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: mandatory where the license line and office sit
palette.usage: The license line and the office, as on countercard_2026_print.pdf, and optionally any premium. Never a ground, panel or rule.

palette.name: Document Paper
palette.usage: The card ground and the only ground or panel colour, as on countercard_2026_print.pdf. Never type or a rule.

palette.name: Mist Grey
palette.usage: Thin dividers or a keyline only. Never type, a ground, a panel or either of the two Heritage Green rules.

palette.name: Heritage Green
palette.usage: The two 1 pt rules of the signature move, each the full card width: the one the producer name sits on and the identical one directly above the Disclosure Text. countercard_2026_print.pdf uses it for its two hairlines only. Never type, a panel, the ground or a premium.

typography: Aldervale Mutual runs four steps. Step 01, display, is the producer name in Lexend SemiBold sentence case at 20 pt on 23 pt leading with -5 tracking, sitting directly on a 1 pt Heritage Green rule that runs the full card width. Step 02, subheading, is the district line in Lexend SemiBold at 11 pt on 14 pt with +20 tracking, immediately under that rule. Step 03, body, is Miller Text Roman at 9 pt on 13 pt with tracking 0 to a maximum of 65 characters, while premiums and all figures break out into IBM Plex Sans Regular at 10 pt on 13 pt as tabular lining figures aligned in a column, never italicised, emboldened or coloured. Step 04, fine print, is the disclosure in Miller Text Roman at 6.5 pt on 9 pt with +15 tracking, sitting directly beneath the second 1 pt Heritage Green rule so the card is bracketed top and bottom in green.
voice: Sober, plain and reassuring, written the way a trusted advisor speaks across a table. No exclamation, no urgency. Example line the brand would write: A whole life policy is a promise that holds its value, and the premium you start with is the premium you keep.
brand_assets_status: The printer who built the counter cards has closed, so the only counter card artwork that survives is the flat press PDF that went to press. Producer headshots are self submitted from personal phones and vary widely. Compliance owns the disclosure language and updates it when a state changes its rules.
values: Nothing may read as an advertisement, and everything must survive the kitchen table. Compliance and honesty come before flourish, and the material should feel as dependable as the carrier behind it.

type_system.signature_move: The pair of rules. The producer name in Lexend SemiBold 20 pt sits directly on a 1 pt Heritage Green line running the full card width, and that identical rule repeats above the 6.5 pt disclosure, so every piece is bracketed top and bottom in green. Inside that bracket the premiums are always tabular lining figures in IBM Plex Sans Regular at 10 pt, aligned in a column.
rules: The producer name sits directly on a 1 pt Heritage Green rule running the full card width, and the identical rule repeats above the disclosure, so every piece is bracketed top and bottom in green.
Premiums are always tabular lining figures in IBM Plex Sans Regular, aligned in a column. Never embolden or colour a premium.
Lexend SemiBold is set sentence case, never caps.
Miller Text Roman sets body and disclosure, and nothing at display size.
Compliance owns the disclosure language. Set it as supplied and never cut it to fit the space.
Nothing may read as an advertisement. No exclamation and no urgency at any step.

palette_rules.distribution: Document Paper is the card ground and the only ground or panel colour, as on countercard_2026_print.pdf. All type is Ink Navy or Slate: the producer name and the Disclosure Text in Ink Navy and the license line and office in Slate, as on countercard_2026_print.pdf; any premium in either. Heritage Green is only the two 1 pt rules that bracket the card. Mist Grey is only for thin dividers or a keyline. Heritage Green and Mist Grey together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons. No type in Heritage Green, Mist Grey or Document Paper, no premium picked out in any colour, bold or italic, and no burst or starburst callout in any colour, as compliance_note.txt rules out.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own natural colour and skin tones and are never tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward the palette. Neutralising a phone's warm or cool cast is allowed; pushing a suit, a face or a wall toward Ink Navy, Slate, Heritage Green or Mist Grey is not.
